id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Something stirs in Heliodor Castle. Something will strike under cover of darkness. Sire, move the people to safety.
"Listen, all! Monsters will come soon! Prepare for battle! Light the bonfires!
"Do not think ill of him. Even a man like Hendrik has yet to sort out all that has happened.
"These days he fights as if to punish himself. I cannot bear to watch.
"I do not want him to fight alone any longer. Please, lend him your strength.
"Your anger is justified. But now, only you can support him.
"If we survive tonight, victory is ours! Prepare and head outside the fortress. {var:1}, I count on you."
